purpose: Explicit audit comparing physical 48CS4 Agent-4 fields against built-in engine assumptions. No silent normalization.

schemaContradictions.impact: Physical rules from NTA bulletins use descriptive names. Engine safely marks them UNRESOLVED in single-rule evaluation without breaking package trust boundary.
schemaContradictions.resolutionPlan: Add canonical alias mapping for entrance exam age limits in future rule normalization update.

schemaContradictions.impact: Temporal and cohort-based qualification conditions observed in real notices. Currently handled via general academic match criteria.
In JEE Main, State of Eligibility is where Class 12 was completed, not domicile residence. Engine domicile rules strictly separate native domicile from exam state.
schemaContradictions.resolutionPlan: Formalize QUALIFYING_STATE vs NATIVE_DOMICILE distinction in CareerProfile.

schemaContradictions.observedInCS4: Percentage-based vertical and horizontal quotas (10% EWS, 27% OBC, 15% SC, 7.5% ST, 5% PwBD horizontal).
schemaContradictions.impact: Entrance exams publish reservation percentages; seat counts are allocated during centralized counseling.
schemaContradictions.resolutionPlan: Support PERCENTAGE_RESERVATION capacity model alongside ABSOLUTE_SEAT capacity model.

schemaContradictions.impact: Agent-4 used descriptive compound verification strings.
